date_scope_check.qualification_retained: SC10-D1: October 31 is preferred because it is the intended start in the October 25 official instruction and is independently supported by AFP’s November 1 report quoting an Ebebiyín local official that the frontier had been closed since Monday morning. VOA’s November 23 retrospective October 30 date remains a documented discrepancy. November 7 field reporting identifies disrupted passage on the Kiossi–Ebebiyín corridor, including merchants and Equatorial Guinean returnees; it does not prove that November 3 was the initial national onset. The November 23 endpoint concerns selected merchants entering from Cameroon, not proof that every post or traveller category reopened, or that the Gabon border simultaneously restored access. Exact first-passage clocks and complete exception coverage remain unknown.
